item.title: Fly tipping yet again at Azile Everitt House, 1st August
item.description:
Someone has decided to dump old toys at the ground floor building entrance. This is yet another fire hazard and to make matters worse we had LFB attend today due to a fire. This is is getting out of hand. At the issue starts with Greenwich council because other than the chute. Our bin store is locked for whatever reason. Either give tenants the key or open it. Every single day there is rubbish left or old items dumped at the entrance of the side of the building. Is it this a third world country that rubbish should be dumped. It is disgusting. This issue needs to be rectified because it gets worse and worse everyday. I’m embarrassed to even let people come round because of the state of the building. Maybe Greenwich should start issuing fines to the entire building just like Southwark council does.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Blendon Terrace, Plumstead
Report on FixMyStreet
